name: Kaitou Z ~Anata no Heart o Nusumimasu~
original_name: 怪盗Z～あなたのハートを盗みます～
source:
Kaitou Z is an antique shop holder on the surface, but also a gentleman thief who breaks into houses and uses hypnotism widely. One day he is asked by one girl to steal a film from some office. He steals the film, but what's the meaning of this ridiculous film?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
怪盗Z表面上经营着一家古董店，实际上却是一名闯入民宅、广泛使用催眠术的绅士怪盗。一天，一名女孩请他从某间办公室偷出一卷胶片。他成功得手，但这卷荒唐胶片究竟意味着什么？

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
